name: ASM-023 robot wrist joint assembly benchmark
description: Intermediate hierarchical CAD assembly benchmark for a compact robot wrist joint with base flange, fork yoke, hub, output plate, bearings, pins, and cap screws.

tasks.prompt: Create a robot wrist joint assembly with a base flange, two yoke plates, repeated cross pins, a central wrist hub with bearing caps, an output tool plate, encoder puck, and repeated cap screws. Use simple reliable solids and meaningful hierarchy.
assumptions: The joint is represented by nested flange/yoke/hub/tooling modules rather than kinematic constraints.
Cap screws and cross pins are repeated functional occurrences; holes are represented by raised cylindrical bosses for robust topology.
Generated STEP, GLB, and topology artifacts are benchmark outputs, not source files.
